entities.name: Somberwald
entities.description: A forested region of drooping pines in the Geier Reach mountains of Stensia on Innistrad, a refuge for wildlife and a dangerous wilderness.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Province of Innistrad containing Somberwald, dominated by vampires.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Region from which wildlife were driven into Somberwald.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Her death preceded the forest becoming a Dronepack hunting ground.

entities.name: Dronepack
entities.description: A faction of werewolves corrupted by Emrakul's flesh-warping influence.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose influence corrupted the Dronepack.

events.summary: Following Avacyn's death, Somberwald becomes a hunting ground for the Dronepack, werewolves corrupted by Emrakul.
events.quote: Following the death of Avacyn , the forest became a hunting ground for the Dronepack
